projectCopy: A light-filled dwelling layered with workshops and quiet gardens.

A retreat with sculptural glazing and a quiet planted courtyard.
A serene wood-clad house arranged around a reflective water terrace.

about.label: About Me
about.title: Elea Gomes
about.copy1: I am currently completing my Master’s degree in Architecture, with the submission of my dissertation expected in July 2026. I consider myself a dedicated, responsible, and enthusiastic person, always eager to learn new skills and embrace new challenges. I value communication and teamwork, and I enjoy collaborating in creative and dynamic environments.
about.copy2: I am passionate about discovering new places and seeking opportunities that allow me to experience international cultures and adventures. Outside of architecture, I spend much of my free time exploring creative activities such as drawing, painting, reading, writing, and crochet, as well as engaging in sports and outdoor activities including volleyball, pilates, dance, hiking, and snorkeling.

studio.title: Studio House
studio.description: A compact atelier-residence designed around a courtyard, generous north light, and material intimacy.
studio.copy: The Studio House is conceived as a calm urban retreat with an internal garden, expressive timber surfaces, and moments of layered daylight. The plan arranges living, working and sleeping around a central courtyard to create varied visual connections.

city.title: City Atrium
city.description: An urban intervention that brings a calm, sculptural atrium into an energetic civic district.
city.copy: City Atrium acts as an anchor for public life, combining transparent gathering spaces with offices above. The scheme emphasizes continuity between street, interior and roof terraces.

heritage.title: Heritage Pavilion
heritage.description: A sensitive cultural pavilion woven into an existing historic setting.
heritage.copy: The Heritage Pavilion is a subtle addition to an existing landscape, respecting context while offering an open exhibition space and contemplative courtyard. The design balances old and new through material restraint and spatial clarity.
